verdict.rationale: Batch jobs accept a caller-supplied reference_id, and the docs say it is preserved for tracking and correlation across the job and status schemas. That covers attaching your own identifier and getting it back in job/status results. However, the webhook documentation describes signing and delivery but never says reference_id is echoed in the webhook payload, and no free-form metadata object is documented. Missing for 10: confirmation that reference_id appears in webhook payloads, support for arbitrary key-value metadata beyond a single reference_id, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
